name: Clutch Bureau
tagline: Run your coaching business like a pro, even if your K/D says otherwise.
positioning: The back office for independent esports coaches: scheduling, VOD review, rosters, and payouts in one place so you can coach instead of chasing Discord DMs.

hero.h1: You coach the aim. We'll handle the paperwork.
hero.sub: Clutch Bureau is the boring-on-purpose business software for esports coaches who are done running their whole operation out of a spreadsheet and three Discord servers.

features.title: No-show insurance
features.description: Automated booking, reminders, and a cancellation policy that actually holds. Students confirm, pay, and show up — or the calendar reclaims the slot for someone who will.

features.title: VOD review that stays organized
features.description: Timestamp notes, drop clips, and send a review your student can rewatch instead of losing your voice memo in a group chat forever.

features.title: Rosters without the guesswork
features.description: Track every student's rank, goals, and last five sessions in one profile. Know who's grinding and who ghosted before you open the app.

features.title: Payouts on autopilot
features.description: Per-seat billing, invoices, and payment reminders that go out without you playing collections agent between scrims.

features.title: Progress your students can see
features.description: Auto-built progress reports so parents and players stop asking 'am I actually getting better' every single week.

features.title: One link for everything
features.description: A booking page that doesn't look like it was made in 2009. Share it, pin it, and stop typing your availability out by hand.

testimonials.quote: I was running a legit coaching business off a Google Sheet and pure spite. Clutch Bureau gave me back my Sundays and cut no-shows by more than half.
testimonials.name: Marcus 'DriftKing' Odom

testimonials.quote: The per-seat pricing just makes sense. I add a coach, I pay for a coach. No 12-page enterprise quote to run a five-person operation.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: My students actually watch the VOD reviews now because they aren't buried in a Discord thread from three weeks ago. That alone paid for it.
testimonials.name: Devon Whitaker

pricing.blurb: For the one-person operation who is also the accountant, marketer, and janitor.
For small academies that have officially outgrown the group chat.
For the org with a logo, a jersey, and an actual finance person.

homepage.footerBlurb: Clutch Bureau is business software for esports coaches who'd rather be coaching. Fewer spreadsheets, fewer no-shows, more GGs.
